newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks close 2.37 pct up on blue chips.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks close 2.37 pct up on blue chips.

text.p: Pakistani stocks blasted over the 2,000-point mark on Wednesday, posting a 2.37 percent rise by the close on fresh buying of blue chips by overseas investors, dealers at the Karachi Stock Exchange said.

The Karachi 100-index closed 46.47 points, or 2.37 percent, up at 2,010.68 at 14.15 p.m. (0915 GMT). Losers led gainers 120 to 87. Blue chips in the energy and telecommunication sectors, which posted fresh gains, propelled the index over the 2,000-point psychological barrier, dealer Salman Naqvi said.
Pakistan State Oil closed 10 rupees up at 430, Shell Pakistan 8.0 higher at 288 and Pakistan Telecom 2.55 rose 2.55 to 42.60. -- Ibrahim Khan 9221-5685192
